title.zh: 修订第1200号共和国法第一编B部分第一目al项第10分项（即《为公共工程拨款并修订第920号共和国法》）的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Sub-Item Ten of Item al, Subsection One, Title B of Section One, Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works and Amending Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty”
title.orig: An Act Amending Sub-Item Ten of Item al, Subsection One, Title B of Section One, Republic Act Numbered Twelve Hundred, Entitled “An Act Appropriating Funds for Public Works and Amending Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty”

text.en:
Sub-item ten of item al, subsection one, Title B of section one, Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(10) Asphalt paving of the following streets, Municipality of Balawan, Negros Oriental: Buenavista Street from Zamora Street to Mabini Street; Mabini Street from Progreso Street to Burgos Street; Burgos Street from Mabini Street to General Luna Street; General Luna Street from Burgos Street to Nueva Street; Independence Street from provincial road to Nueva Street; La Libertad Street from provincial road to Rizal Street; Martires Street from provincial road to Progreso Street; Progreso Street from General Luna Street to Martires Street; Rizal Street from General Luna Street to La Libertad Street; Nueva Street from General Luna Street to Independence Street ₱15,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 14, 1956.
